body:
I see my archive's request slip returning stamped "REFUSED," and it stings worse than any cold wind in winter. I take a deep breath, feeling the fire inside me ignite like an ember at dawn. My eyes dart around the room, searching for someone who can justify this rejection. 

My mind races through every possible reason why the request should be denied - lack of proper documentation, insufficient time, or perhaps, just pure stubbornness on their part. A wave of frustration washes over me as I realize there must be some flaw, any flaw, that could change this outcome.
